plugins.name: intake
plugins.description: Per-project QA profile: /qa-init scans the target project once — issue tracker repo, issue templates, labels, app launch method, test conventions — and freezes it into qa/intake.md, which every other QA plugin reads. Committed to the project repo so every user shares one profile.

plugins.name: testrun
plugins.description: Test execution: launches the actual product and exercises it — plan-driven when a plan exists, ad-hoc smoke otherwise. Every verdict carries evidence (command output, screenshot, log); run records land under qa/runs/. Report, don't fix: findings become issues, never edits to product code.

plugins.name: bugreport
plugins.description: Bug filing discipline: a confirmed, actually-reproduced defect becomes a tracker issue that follows the project's own issue template and labels (per qa/intake.md), with duplicate search before filing and a standard form as fallback.

plugins.name: stats
plugins.description: Trust accounting: /qa-stats follows every issue filed from the workspace's run records to its tracker outcome and reports the stack's production signal — acceptance rate (fixed), noise rate (closed not-planned), duplicate conversions, UNFILED reasons. Read-only, no hooks.

plugins.name: regress
plugins.description: Regression tests with an adoption gate: /regress turns a confirmed bug into an automated test adopted only if it fails on the bug commit and passes stably (k=5) on the fix. Adopted tests live in the QA workspace and run on every /testrun; anything that can't prove itself is discarded, not committed.

plugins.name: qa-cycle
plugins.description: The QA cycle spine: owns the session state file (projects/<owner>-<repo>/state.md) and the PreToolUse gate that refuses any write the transition table in docs/specs/qa-cycle-state-machine.md disallows for the current phase. Human-only transitions require a matching unconsumed verdict token minted by signoff.

plugins.name: signoff
plugins.description: Human sign-off: /go-no-go records a Go/No-Go/Shipped-Under-Exception verdict against an exit-readiness bundle. Captures an unambiguous verdict from the user's own turn as a single-use token that authorizes exactly one qa-cycle transition.

plugins.name: qa-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install QA environment bundle: pulls in the whole tokenmaxxxer QA stack (intake, testrun, bugreport, stats, regress, qa-cycle, signoff) as dependencies. Contains no code of its own.
